messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: transform
parts:
Hi,

thanks for the report. This is due to a "bug" in getImage(). I've
fixed it for the next release. Until then, it should be enough to put
the transform function in a list, e.g.:

plotImage(cf1,transform=list(log2), palette=rainbow(256))

Cheers

Henrik
